The evidence in Source [S2] explicitly contains the line `Voxels[id.x + Dims.x * (id.y + Dims.y * id.z)] = value;`. This formula calculates the linear index for a 3D array. In this formula, `id.z` is multiplied by the largest factor (`Dims.x * Dims.y`), meaning it changes the least frequently as the index increments (slowest varying). `id.y` is multiplied by `Dims.x`, making it intermediate. `id.x` is added directly, making it change most frequently (fastest varying). Thus, the evidence supports the claim that the z-axis is the slowest varying, y is intermediate, and x is the fastest varying dimension.
